steps.clueRiddle:
The couch becomes a racing machine.
Steady thumbs win Heat Fifteen... we mean One!
steps.clueReveal: Take the best seat on the couch. Heat One has two games: the rapids and the maze. Beat them both!

challenges.title: Canoe the Rapids
challenges.instructions: Drag your finger to steer the canoe. Dodge every rock. Survive sixty seconds!

challenges.title: Maze Escape
challenges.instructions: Drag your racer to the red exit gate. No cutting through walls. Champions do not give up!

challenges.title: Animal Trivia Encore
challenges.instructions: The famous animal deck from the trip is back. Twelve questions this time. Can you still beat it?

steps.funFact: The canoe game was born on the drive home from Québec City.

steps.clueRiddle:
Every race team needs a pit crew.
Today the pit crew is YOU.
steps.clueReveal: Speed bump! Make a small snack or drink for every person home. Deliver it all in three minutes.

challenges.title: Pit Crew Snack Run
challenges.instructions: Start the stopwatch in the kitchen. Bring every team member a snack or a drink. Careful hands — no spills!

steps.funFact: Real pit crews can change four car tires in two seconds.

steps.clueRiddle:
A tiny café just opened at home.
The waiter only speaks French!
steps.clueReveal: A parent is now a French café waiter. Order your snack in French. Then taste it and judge it like a pro.

challenges.title: Order in French
challenges.instructions: Practise the phrase on the card twice. Then say it to the café waiter. Do not forget to say merci!

challenges.title: Snack Judge
challenges.instructions: Taste your café order slowly. Think about the crunch and the flavour. Give it your maple leaf rating.

steps.funFact: Biscuit means cookie in French. You already knew merci!

steps.clueRiddle:
Back on the couch for the final heat.
Then the track crew makes the pit lane neat!
steps.clueReveal: Heat Two, back on the couch! Play Bagel Catch, then House Bingo. After the race, the track crew cleans the track!

challenges.title: Bagel Catch Championship
challenges.instructions: Slide the basket to catch falling bagels. Dodge the pigeons. Beat your best score from the trip!

challenges.title: House Bingo
challenges.instructions: A brand-new card of things inside the house. Spot each thing and tap its square. Four in a row wins!

challenges.title: Track Crew Cleanup
challenges.instructions: The race is over — the track crew takes the course apart. Find four games or toys in the living room. Pack each one up and put it away where it lives!
checklist: First game packed up and put away
Second game packed up and put away
Third game packed up and put away
Fourth game packed up and put away
Couch cushions back in racing order
challenges.photoPrompt: Pit crew salute over the clean track!

steps.funFact: Montréal bagels are boiled in honey water. You watched it happen!

steps.clueRiddle:
The mat is parked by the biggest seat.
One rival's race ends tonight.
steps.clueReveal: Race to the mat in the living room. Tonight is HUGE. After this mat, only two teams remain!
steps.funFact: The last leg before a finale is always the most dramatic one.
